checkpoints.description: [1/2] Use line-art SVG icons for card annual-fee status

impact_assessment.why: Vision review of the Cards view fee row found colorful emojis (tag, hourglass, money, check, shield) clashing with the app's monochrome line-art icons (G-003 aesthetic cohesion).
impact_assessment.benefits: Aidat banner and all four fee states now use line-art SVGs; before/after vision reviews approved (95 -> 97).
impact_assessment.risks: Two render-only changes in js/views.js; amounts and status text preserved so tests pass; 111/111 tests pass.
impact_assessment.mitigation: npm test 111/111, ui verify + ui finish --reviewed, vision analysis of both card-fee screenshots, check --strict 4/4.
